items.title: Senior Research Scientist
items.llm_summary: The Senior Research Scientist role involves developing state-of-the-art algorithms and software for real-world scientific applications. The role requires prototyping algorithms and implementing high-performance software across tactical and web systems.
items.role_brief: Lead the development of high-performance software and advanced algorithms to solve complex information science problems.
responsibilities: Create mathematically principled solutions to information science problems
Prototype state-of-the-art algorithms in an agile development environment
Implement high-performance software for tactical systems and web applications
Use high-fidelity modeling and simulation environments to quantify technology benefits

items.title: Research Scientist
items.llm_summary: The Research Scientist role focuses on developing state-of-the-art algorithms and software to solve scientific problems with real-world applications. The position involves prototyping algorithms in an agile environment and implementing high-performance software.
items.role_brief: Develop and implement high-performance software and mathematically principled algorithms for mission-critical defense systems.
responsibilities: Create mathematically principled solutions to information science problems
Prototype state-of-the-art algorithms in an agile development environment
Implement high-performance software for tactical systems and web applications
Use high-fidelity modeling and simulation environments to quantify technology benefits
